title: Teaching Children the Rights of Parents and al-Birr (birr al-walidayn) towards Them

text_simplified: Parents must teach their children the rights of parents and al-birr (birr al-walidayn) towards them, while emphasizing the importance of salah, truthfulness, and ihsan. Children should also be guided to obey Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, and to avoid lying and cheating.

review_defects.why: The English adds the specific term 'birr al-walidayn' which is not in the Arabic. The Arabic says 'al-birr bihima' (dutifulness towards them), not the technical phrase 'birr al-walidayn'.
The English inserts the parenthetical 'birr al-walidayn' which is not present in the Arabic. The Arabic simply says 'al-birr bihima' (dutifulness towards them).
